Hymn 136: I Know That My Redeemer Lives
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: Lewis D. Edwards

This is hymn number 136 titled "I Know That My Redeemer Lives" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Lewis D. Edwards and the lyrics were written by Samuel Medley.
